Expenditure, category overspend, and cash runway for July 2026 cannot be computed from this source. This is a data-quality failure, not a read failure — the sheet loaded fully, it's just not been kept up.

_comment2: Blocks below added 2026-08-09 from the SAME workbook, 'Annual Overview' and 'Monthly Overview' tabs only (per Joseph's instruction). Actuals — not the Monthly Budget tab's assumptions. The pre-existing blocks above are untouched and remain the record of the July report.

actuals.source: Google Drive — 'My Income & Expenses' → Annual Overview tab (monthly totals) + Monthly Overview tab (category split for the selected month)
actuals.note: Annual Overview is Joseph's personal ledger. It does NOT reconcile with the Monthly Budget tab's combined take-home assumption of $8,880/mo — see conflicts.incomeBasis.

incomeByCategory._note: Annual Overview → Monthly Income table. One row per category, values Jan..Aug 2026.

expenseByCategory._note: Monthly Overview tab, which computes ONE month at a time from its own Month/Year selector. It was set to July 2026 when read, so this split is July 2026 only. Other months have totals but no category split available from these two tabs.

balances._note: The five fields Joseph fills in on the dashboard. null = not yet supplied; the dashboard shows 'unknown', never 0. Editing on the page is session-only until exported here. All SGD.

liabilities._note: Per Joseph, 2026-08-09. School Loan is the $33,000 owed to his mother (the same figure the 'School Fees' savings goal carries). It starts amortising at $1,000/mo from Sep 2026, not before. Mortgage is not drawn until Q1 2028 and is $0 today. Slots 3-5 are placeholders Joseph has not yet named.

rows.name: School Loan
rows.note: Owed to Joseph's mother. Begins reducing $1,000/mo from Sep 2026.

rows.name: Mortgage
rows.note: $440,000 remaining, split with Melissa. Not drawn until Q1 2028, so $0 outstanding today. Monthly repayment not yet known. Excluded from the net-worth line because the property it buys has no recorded value — counting the debt without the asset would show a false collapse. It still appears in the liabilities chart once drawn, and as a dotted marker on the cash map.

incomeBasis.title: Two different incomes in one workbook
incomeBasis.detail: The Monthly Budget tab assumes $8,880/mo combined take-home (Joseph $4,800 + Melissa $4,080). The Annual Overview tab's actuals average $1,314/mo income for Jan-Aug 2026, peaking at $3,020. These are not the same thing and cannot both drive a projection. Nothing has been reconciled — the dashboard lets you pick which basis the cash map runs on.
